name: Chang'e 2
tagline: Second Chinese lunar orbiter; first to visit asteroid 4179 Toutatis
description: China's second lunar orbiter, launched 2010-10-01. Chang'e 2 orbited the Moon from 2010 to 2011, then departed lunar orbit in June 2011 for an extended deep-space mission. It proceeded to the Sun-Earth L2 point (arriving August 2011), then departed L2 in April 2012 for a historic flyby of asteroid 4179 Toutatis, executing a close approach on 2012-12-13 at ~770 m distance — the first spacecraft to visit the asteroid. After the Toutatis encounter, Chang'e 2 continued into deep space on a heliocentric trajectory, becoming a drifting interplanetary object.
best_known_for: Second Chinese lunar orbiter; first spacecraft flyby of asteroid 4179 Toutatis (Dec 13, 2012, ~770 m closest approach)
